maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is fees from carriers and agents for customer leads and referrals in auto insurance, not repair or servicing of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by private insurance carriers and agents for consumer leads and policy referrals; consumers use it free.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows organically through its online insurance marketplace and AI matching technology; only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Carriers and agents can buy leads from many competing marketplaces and channels; switching is easy.
